title: Across Viewpoints and Time: Trajectory-Generalizable Physical Attacks on World Models and Video Understanding Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.15343v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models and video understanding models are increasingly deployed in dynamic visual environments, yet their robustness to physical adversarial threats remains largely underexplored. We study whether a single physical adversarial texture can mislead the victim model across different real-world scenarios where observing viewpoints vary along uncontrolled object--camera trajectories. We identify that heterogeneous video semantics and trajectories induce poorly aligned gradients for optimizing the adversarial texture. To address that, we propose the Trajectory-aware adversarial Alignment and Refinement Attack (TARA), which incorporates trajectory-aware optimization to capture the evolving geometric variations of a printed texture under real-world scenarios. translated_title: 跨越视角与时间：针对世界模型与视频理解模型的轨迹可泛化物理攻击
translated_abstract: 世界模型和视频理解模型越来越多地被部署在动态视觉环境中，然而它们对物理对抗威胁的鲁棒性在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。我们研究了单一的物理对抗纹理是否能够在不同的真实世界场景中误导受害模型，在这些场景中，观察视角沿着不受控制的物体-相机轨迹而变化。我们发现异构的视频语义和轨迹会导致用于优化对抗纹理的梯度难以对齐。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了轨迹感知对抗对齐与细化攻击（TARA），该方法结合了轨迹感知优化，以捕捉打印纹理在真实世界场景中不断演变的几何变化。为了提高跨实例优化的兼容性，TARA引入了轨迹感知对比对齐，以鼓励来自不同视频-轨迹组合的受攻击表征保持一致性（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了轨迹感知对抗攻击方法TARA，使单一的物理对抗纹理能够在视角和物体-相机轨迹不断变化的真实世界场景中，跨时间地误导世界模型和视频理解模型。
en_tdlr: TARA, a trajectory-aware adversarial attack, enables a single physical adversarial texture to generalize across varying viewpoints and uncontrolled object-camera trajectories, misleading world models and video understanding models in real-world scenarios over time.
